name.en: Please write your full name at the top of the form.
name.zh: 請在表格上方寫下你的全名。

narrow.en: The path became narrow as we approached the mountain village.
narrow.zh: 我們接近山村時，小路變得很狹窄。

nation.en: Each nation develops policies based on its own needs.
nation.zh: 每個國家都會依自己的需求制定政策。

national.en: The national museum attracts visitors from many different regions.
national.zh: 這座國家博物館吸引來自許多地區的遊客。

native.en: She is a native speaker who also teaches English grammar.
native.zh: 她是母語人士，也教授英文文法。

natural.en: The park is known for its natural scenery and clean air.
natural.zh: 這座公園以自然景觀與清新空氣聞名。

naturally.en: Children naturally learn many things by observing people around them.
naturally.zh: 孩子天生會透過觀察身邊的人學到許多事。

nature.en: Spending time in nature can help people relax and focus.
nature.zh: 接觸大自然能幫助人放鬆並專注。

near.en: A small bookstore opened near the station last month.
near.zh: 上個月車站附近開了一家小書店。

nearby.en: We found a nearby café where we could finish our homework.
nearby.zh: 我們找到附近一家可以完成作業的咖啡店。

nearly.en: Nearly all the students completed the survey on time.
nearly.zh: 幾乎所有學生都準時完成問卷。

necessary.en: Careful preparation is necessary for a successful science experiment.
necessary.zh: 仔細準備是成功完成科學實驗的必要條件。

neck.en: He stretched his neck after sitting at the desk for hours.
neck.zh: 坐在書桌前好幾個小時後，他伸展了頸部。

need.en: Students need enough sleep to stay focused during class.
need.zh: 學生需要充足睡眠，才能在課堂上保持專注。

negative.en: Too much negative feedback can reduce a student's confidence.
negative.zh: 過多負面回饋可能降低學生的自信。

neighbor.en: Our neighbor helped us carry the boxes upstairs.
neighbor.zh: 鄰居幫我們把箱子搬上樓。

neighborhood.en: The neighborhood has changed a lot since the new station opened.
neighborhood.zh: 新車站開放後，這個社區改變了很多。

neither.en: Neither answer is correct, so read the question again.
neither.zh: 兩個答案都不正確，所以請再讀一次題目。

nervous.en: She felt nervous before giving her first speech in English.
nervous.zh: 第一次用英文演講前，她感到很緊張。

network.en: The school network allows students to access online learning materials.
network.zh: 學校網路讓學生可以存取線上學習資料。

never.en: I never submit an assignment before checking it carefully.
never.zh: 我從不在仔細檢查前交作業。

new.en: The teacher introduced a new method for reviewing vocabulary.
new.zh: 老師介紹了一種複習單字的新方法。

news.en: We checked the news to learn more about the storm.
news.zh: 我們查看新聞以了解更多暴風雨資訊。

newspaper.en: The newspaper published an article about local environmental problems.
newspaper.zh: 這家報紙刊登了一篇關於當地環境問題的文章。

next.en: Please read the next section before tomorrow's class.
next.zh: 請在明天上課前讀完下一部分。

nice.en: It was nice to study outside on such a cool afternoon.
nice.zh: 在這麼涼爽的午後到戶外讀書很舒服。

night.en: The temperature dropped quickly after night fell.

nine.en: The meeting starts at nine tomorrow morning.
nine.zh: 會議明天早上九點開始。

no.en: There is no simple answer to every social problem.
no.zh: 不是每個社會問題都有簡單答案。

nobody.en: Nobody knew the correct answer until the teacher explained it.
nobody.zh: 直到老師解釋前，沒有人知道正確答案。

noise.en: Traffic noise made it difficult to concentrate on reading.
noise.zh: 交通噪音讓人很難專心閱讀。

none.en: None of the computers worked after the power failure.
none.zh: 停電後，所有電腦都無法使用。

normal.en: It is normal to feel tired after a long day of study.
normal.zh: 讀書一整天後感到疲累是正常的。

normally.en: The library normally closes at nine in the evening.
normally.zh: 圖書館通常晚上九點關門。

north.en: The hikers continued north until they reached the river.
north.zh: 登山客一路往北走，直到抵達河邊。

northern.en: The northern part of the island receives more rain in winter.
northern.zh: 島嶼北部在冬天有較多降雨。

nose.en: The cold air made my nose feel uncomfortable.
nose.zh: 冷空氣讓我的鼻子感到不舒服。

not.en: This method is not difficult once you understand the basic steps.
not.zh: 一旦了解基本步驟，這個方法其實不難。

note.en: Please make a note of the homework deadline in your planner.
note.zh: 請把作業截止日期記在行事曆裡。

nothing.en: Nothing changed after we repeated the experiment under the same conditions.
nothing.zh: 在相同條件下重做實驗後，沒有任何變化。

notice.en: Did you notice the difference between the two graphs?
notice.zh: 你有注意到這兩張圖表之間的差異嗎？

novel.en: The class read a short novel about friendship and responsibility.
novel.zh: 全班閱讀了一本關於友誼與責任的短篇小說。

November.en: The school festival will be held in November this year.
November.zh: 今年校慶會在十一月舉行。

now.en: We have enough information to make a decision now.
now.zh: 我們現在已經有足夠資訊可以做決定。

nowadays.en: Nowadays, many students use digital tools for studying.
nowadays.zh: 現在許多學生會使用數位工具來學習。

number.en: Please write your student number beside your name.
number.zh: 請在姓名旁寫上你的學號。

nurse.en: The nurse checked his temperature before calling the doctor.
nurse.zh: 護理師在叫醫師前先量了他的體溫。

object.en: Each object in the experiment was weighed carefully.
object.zh: 實驗中的每個物體都被仔細秤重。

objective.en: The main objective of the project is to reduce food waste.
objective.zh: 這項專題的主要目標是減少食物浪費。

observe.en: Students observe the plants every day and record any changes.
observe.zh: 學生每天觀察植物並記錄任何變化。

obtain.en: We need to obtain permission before using the laboratory after school.
obtain.zh: 放學後使用實驗室前，我們需要取得許可。

obvious.en: It became obvious that the first plan would not work.
obvious.zh: 很明顯第一個計畫行不通。

obviously.en: The machine was obviously damaged and could not be used safely.
obviously.zh: 這台機器顯然已損壞，無法安全使用。

occasion.en: On this occasion, the class invited a scientist to speak.
occasion.zh: 這一次，全班邀請了一位科學家來演講。

occasionally.en: I occasionally study at the library when my home is noisy.
occasionally.zh: 家裡太吵時，我偶爾會到圖書館讀書。

occupy.en: Large books occupy most of the space on this shelf.
occupy.zh: 大型書籍占據了這個書架的大部分空間。

occur.en: Small errors often occur when people work too quickly.
occur.zh: 人們做事太快時常會出現小錯誤。

ocean.en: Plastic waste can travel long distances across the ocean.
ocean.zh: 塑膠垃圾可能漂過海洋很長的距離。

October.en: The competition begins in October and ends in December.
October.zh: 這項比賽十月開始，十二月結束。

of.en: The results of the experiment were recorded in a table.
of.zh: 實驗結果被記錄在表格中。

off.en: Please turn off the lights before leaving the classroom.

offer.en: The school will offer extra English classes next semester.
offer.zh: 學校下學期會提供額外的英文課。

office.en: Please take the form to the school office before noon.
office.zh: 請在中午前把表格送到校務處。

official.en: The official schedule will be posted on the website tomorrow.
official.zh: 正式行程表明天會公布在網站上。

often.en: Students often remember information better after explaining it to others.
often.zh: 學生把資訊解釋給別人聽後，通常會記得更牢。

oil.en: The machine needs a small amount of oil to operate smoothly.
oil.zh: 這台機器需要少量潤滑油才能順暢運作。

old.en: The old bridge was repaired before the rainy season began.
old.zh: 雨季開始前，這座老橋先完成了修繕。

on.en: Please place your books on the table before class begins.
on.zh: 上課前請把書放在桌上。

once.en: We review these vocabulary words once every week.
once.zh: 我們每週複習這些單字一次。

one.en: Choose one example that best supports your main point.
one.zh: 選一個最能支持你主要論點的例子。

only.en: Only a few students finished the difficult task without help.
only.zh: 只有少數學生在沒有幫助下完成這項困難任務。

open.en: Please open the window to improve the airflow in the room.
open.zh: 請打開窗戶，改善房間內的空氣流通。

operate.en: Students must learn how to operate the equipment safely.
operate.zh: 學生必須學會如何安全操作設備。

operation.en: The operation of the machine becomes easier after some practice.
operation.zh: 練習一段時間後，操作這台機器會變得更容易。

opinion.en: Everyone was invited to share an opinion during the discussion.
opinion.zh: 討論時每個人都被邀請分享自己的意見。

opportunity.en: The exchange program gives students an opportunity to experience another culture.
opportunity.zh: 交換計畫讓學生有機會體驗另一種文化。

oppose.en: Some residents oppose the plan because they worry about traffic.
oppose.zh: 一些居民反對這項計畫，因為他們擔心交通問題。

opposite.en: The library is on the opposite side of the street.
opposite.zh: 圖書館在街道的另一側。

option.en: Online study is one option for students who live far away.
option.zh: 對住得遠的學生而言，線上學習是一個選項。

or.en: You can submit the assignment online or hand it in personally.
or.zh: 你可以線上繳交作業，也可以親自交。

orange.en: She packed an orange and a sandwich for lunch.
orange.zh: 她帶了一顆柳橙和一個三明治當午餐。

order.en: Please put the events in the correct order before answering.
order.zh: 回答前請把事件按正確順序排列。

ordinary.en: The experiment uses ordinary household materials that are easy to find.
ordinary.zh: 這個實驗使用容易找到的日常家用品。

organize.en: Students helped organize the books by subject and level.
organize.zh: 學生協助依主題和程度整理書籍。

organization.en: Good organization can make a long report easier to understand.
organization.zh: 良好的組織能讓長篇報告更容易理解。

original.en: The final design was very different from the original idea.
original.zh: 最後的設計和原本的想法非常不同。

other.en: Some students prefer reading, while other students learn better by listening.
other.zh: 有些學生偏好閱讀，其他學生則用聽的學得更好。

otherwise.en: Please save your work now; otherwise, you may lose your changes.
otherwise.zh: 請現在儲存工作，否則可能會遺失變更。

our.en: Our class will present the project results next Friday.
our.zh: 我們班下星期五會報告專題成果。

out.en: We went out during lunch to buy some food.
out.zh: 午餐時間我們出去買了一些食物。

outside.en: Several students waited outside the classroom before the test.
outside.zh: 考試前有幾名學生在教室外等候。

over.en: The temperature stayed over thirty degrees throughout the afternoon.
over.zh: 整個下午氣溫都維持在三十度以上。

overall.en: The overall result was better than the team had expected.
overall.zh: 整體結果比團隊原先預期的更好。

overcome.en: She overcame her fear of speaking by practicing every week.
overcome.zh: 她透過每週練習克服了對口說的恐懼。

own.en: Students should explain the idea in their own words.
own.zh: 學生應該用自己的話解釋這個觀念。

owner.en: The shop owner decided to stay open one hour later.
owner.zh: 店主決定延後一小時打烊。
